note: conceptId suffixed because atlas node 'resonance' already exists; this page is the driven damped mass-spring view of it

title.zh: 共振：被推着的弹簧振子

description.zh: 固有频率、阻尼比、稳态振幅、共振曲线与相位滞后；线性单自由度模型。
description.en: Natural frequency, damping ratio, steady-state amplitude, the resonance curve and phase lag in a linear one-degree-of-freedom model.

label.zh: 给振动加上阻尼和推力
label.en: Add damping and a push to an oscillation

reason.zh: 自由振动加上阻尼与周期推力，就得到稳态振幅随频率变化的共振曲线。
reason.en: Adding damping and a periodic push to free oscillation gives a steady-state amplitude that varies with frequency: the resonance curve.

label.en: The mechanical version of the same effect

reason.zh: 本页用质量与弹簧演示图谱中“共振”节点所说的频率选择性。
reason.en: This page shows the frequency selectivity that the atlas resonance node describes, using a mass and a spring.

label.en: The resonance peak is a frequency response

reason.zh: A(Ω) 与 φ(Ω) 正是该振子作为线性系统的幅频与相频响应。
reason.en: A(Ω) and φ(Ω) are exactly this oscillator's amplitude and phase frequency response as a linear system.

title.zh: 为什么推秋千要踩中节拍？
title.en: Why must you push a swing in time?
